failures.title: Storage path split
failures.statement: Joining a storage directory and a file name, then splitting the result, gives back the same directory and the same file name.
failures.witness: dirs = ["."], leading = true, trailing = false, name = "a"; assertion failed: `(left == right)`

failures.title: JSON key rewrite keeps keys
failures.statement: Rewriting JSON keys to start lower-case keeps every value and the same number of keys in every object, at every depth.
failures.witness: src = Object { "SSN": Null, "Ssn": Null, }; assertion failed: `(left == right)`
